input.summary: Signs on to the Meridian Core servicing console, searches for a member by number, opens their record and returns the current balance and account number of their Regular Savings account.

outcomes.name: MEMBER_NOT_FOUND
outcomes.description: The core holds no member with that number. The search screen reports it in place of a results table; this is a legitimate answer to the caller's question, not a failure.

outcomes.name: ACCESS_DENIED
outcomes.description: The signed-on teller profile is not entitled to this member record. Detected by HTTP status as well as wording, since the status does not depend on how the vendor phrases the message.

outcomes.name: SESSION_EXPIRED
outcomes.description: The console signed the service session out part-way through the flow. A replay cannot sign itself back in safely, so a person has to.

outcomes.name: CORE_UNAVAILABLE
outcomes.description: The core returned an error page instead of a screen. Detected by status code, which is wording-independent.
